posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
as previous
A1 = animation (autotiles)
A2 = ground (autotiles)
A3 = building (autotiles)
A4 = walls (autotiles)
A5 = normal (not autotiles)
B-E = objects
this may be true to MZ as well.
if you make custom tiles, it's wise to follow the sheet size and structure
to paint over or place what was there.
you can't just blindly set a tileset into those slots (its possible, but wrong preview)
so if you set object in A1, you get that behavior, and if you follow the size and what
on the sheet that has A1 behind it (as reference for placement) you shouldn't get
that issue.
so double check and use default tileset as reference for custom tileset to avoid
this issue in the future

posts.body:
Can I use this thread to quickly ask about one more thing?
I'm trying to create an event NPC that is set to approach aggressively, and if the player character is touched, then battle immediately starts. I'm including a screenshot of my best attempt to get the settings right, but the NPC still mostly runs around the player character and only initiates combat occasionally if I walk into them as they're walking into me (or something similar to this.)
How do I get that "Fear and Hunger" style effect where an overworld MOB lumbers towards you, and when you're caught it's time to fight?

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
@Torblevox
wrong trigger
Player touch activates on the PLAYER moving on the event, the event's move does nothing.
Event touch activates on the EVENT moving on the player, that is what you need here.
But it's usually better to make a new topic for a different problem, especially if it isn't an easy short answer.
